actions.action: Replace the opaque preset with inspectable starting choices
actions.mechanism: Named starting choices expose their exact settings; manual changes remain Custom until the owner explicitly chooses otherwise.
actions.implementation: Offer Review drafts and Custom. Retain all 18 toggles in keyboard-accessible groups; preview changes before applying another starting choice.
actions.check: Load existing custom combinations, edit unrelated invite details, and verify every permission remains unchanged without an explicit role change.
actions.risk: Starting choices can become outdated; version their permission definitions.

actions.action: Require explicit selection for publishing and billing
actions.mechanism: Sensitive privileges cannot be authorized merely by choosing a preset or copying an existing role.
actions.implementation: For new invites, require separate owner selections for publishing and billing. Flag calculated sensitive access without those selections and block sending.
actions.check: Copy a role containing publishing and billing; verify sending remains blocked until both privileges are explicitly selected or removed.
actions.risk: Indirect grants need actionable explanations; preserve every combination through explicit selection.

actions.action: Show what the teammate can actually do
actions.mechanism: A live capability summary translates calculated effective permissions into concrete outcomes rather than leaving owners to interpret toggles.
actions.implementation: Before sending, show Can review drafts, Can publish, and Can manage billing with allowed, denied, or unresolved states and contributing settings.
actions.check: Exercise combinations where effective access differs from an individual toggle; verify the summary matches calculation and updates using keyboard-only interaction.
actions.risk: Unresolved calculations must never appear as denied; announce updates accessibly.

actions.action: Check the invite against the owner's stated intent
actions.mechanism: An independent task expectation detects inconsistencies without guessing which permissions the owner intended to change.
actions.implementation: Record Review drafts, must not publish as the invite goal. Recalculate before sending; block contradictions and offer keyboard-accessible links to relevant settings.
actions.check: Inject a publishing grant after preview; assert the final check catches it and no invite request is sent.
actions.risk: Do not auto-correct custom roles; owners must revise settings or explicitly revise their goal.
